missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Сведение' stays in the nominative as the subject of an equational sentence. 'Важное' is the agreeing neuter adjective. A clean predicate pattern.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Сведение' is the accusative direct object of 'сообщил', identical to the nominative for neuter nouns. 'Мне' is the dative recipient. A reporting pattern.
Strategic focus: Genitive after нет. 'Сведения' is genitive, required by 'нет' in a 'у... нет' frame. 'Точного' agrees in the neuter genitive. Expresses a lack.
Strategic focus: Dative after благодаря. 'Сведению' is dative, governed by 'благодаря'. 'Этому' agrees in the neuter dative. Expresses the helpful cause.

missions.phrase: Он поделился со мной важным сведением.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental after поделиться. 'Сведением' is the instrumental form required by 'поделился'. 'Важным' agrees in the neuter instrumental. A sharing pattern.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Сведении' is the prepositional form after 'в'. 'Этом' agrees in the neuter prepositional. A natural way to point inside a piece of information.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Сведения' is the nominative plural, the standard way to say information in Russian. 'Свежие' agrees in the plural and 'нам' is the dative needer.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Сведения' is the accusative plural object of 'собирает', identical to the nominative plural for neuter nouns. 'Все' agrees in the plural.

missions.phrase: У нас мало сведений о нём.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Сведений' is the genitive plural after the quantifier 'мало'. 'О нём' shows the topic. Practises the zero-ending genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 'Сведениях' is the prepositional plural after 'в'. 'Этих' agrees in the plural and 'много' takes the genitive 'ошибок'. A reflective remark.
